status: Implementation started with source audit; canonical fallback is incomplete and unqualified

observations.fact: Canonical BrowserClient owns WebTransport directly; its open path requires secure WebTransport and WebCrypto.
The existing WebRTC negotiation still sends offer-ready and waits for answer plus ready, using its separate correlation state.
Existing BrowserVoiceSession owns RTCPeerConnection and a separate WebSocket with loopback-only ws URL validation and its own signaling lease.
Canonical hosting installs native QUIC and optional WebTransport profiles. It has no canonical WebSocket config/listener installation.
The existing loopback WS parity listener uses UctpCoordinator and a v0 descriptor. It is not the required canonical WSS/WebRTC fallback.
The pinned upstream already provides a canonical TLS WebSocket text-frame driver with Origin/mount checks and profile-owned authenticated lifetime. Reuse this driver.
The native datagram media owner explicitly refuses WebSocket; attaching the existing datagram path cannot provide WebRTC media.
The existing WebRTC bridge uses the older connection substrate payloads. It cannot be treated as canonical lifecycle integration without implementing current scoped negotiation/authority.

implementation_order: Add explicitly configured canonical WSS hosting/discovery with the same canonical profile, current service authorization, shared physical budgets, signing lifetime and owned shutdown/drop. Cover Origin/mount/TLS refusal and expose HTTP/OpenAPI reference.
Separate canonical signed browser control from its transport, reusing envelope validation, operation correlation, bounded queues, receipts and current authentication over WSS.

Bind actual WebRTC SDP/ICE/media to the exact canonical Connection and parameter operation, with current source/target authority and bounded per-connection candidate state. Replace the old browser-only control dialect; preserve capture/permission ownership without a legacy compatibility path.

Force WT/UDP failure and exercise the same public conversation and transition commands in actual Chrome and Firefox. An accepted or uncertain dial/message retains its original logical ID; transport selection cannot resubmit it. Explicitly refuse unsupported migration.
Verify actual identified duplex media/data, loss/recovery, revocation, closure and owned teardown, with separate runtime evidence for each required browser profile.
scope: Read-only current-source contract audit. No working canonical WSS/WebRTC fallback, behavioral test pass, completed task, remote/provider or publication claim.
